description: An elderly man with grey hair and a leather apron leans over a wooden workbench, holding a brass-rimmed magnifying glass to his eye while he works on a small steel piece in a vise. Rows of small steel punches stand in wooden racks, with small copper blocks, a hammer and files on the bench. A forge pot with glowing coals, a lit candle and stacked old books sit in a dim, warm workshop. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.
